name: Engine-independent deck identity
structure: Evaluate whether named primary engine is essential or optional by testing missing-engine states.
acceptance: Require viable fallback and independent rival response.

name: Payoff-first design
structure: Choose a consequential payoff, identify enabling conditions and ensure access.
acceptance: Do not equate synergy or access with actual scoring.

name: Redundant engine paths
structure: Track two different payoff routes rather than relying on one named asset.
acceptance: Check overlap, shared prerequisites and legal effects.

name: Failure-state card distribution
structure: When engine absent, examine whether remaining roles enable alternate play.
acceptance: Conditional composition is not proof of sufficient hand quality.

name: Conditional transformation
structure: Change engine density by starting order and predicted opposing answer coverage.
acceptance: Require legal swaps; opponent may adapt or retain useful answers.

name: Performance versus deck quality
structure: Review pilot execution separately from list construction after an event.
acceptance: Self-reported outcomes do not establish causality.

name: Alternative engine hit
structure: Evaluate apparently weaker payoff by next-turn utility rather than immediate size.
acceptance: Verify ready state, cost and future access.

name: Indirect metagame effects
structure: Removing a dominant strategy can alter relative prospects of other decks.
acceptance: Forecast requires dated matchup and field evidence; no deterministic prediction.

name: Second-order matchup pressure
structure: An opponent's decline may remove favorable pairings as well as unfavorable ones.
acceptance: Separate direct matchup changes from field composition.

name: Market signals as hypothesis
structure: Treat card sales and price changes as possible indicators of interest.
acceptance: No conversion from sales to tournament share without evidence.

name: Main-deck answer promotion
structure: Move narrow interaction into baseline when plausible target coverage grows.
acceptance: Compare dead draws, alternative slots and actual prevalence.

name: Answer packaging choice
structure: Compare similar answers carried by different card types and different resource roles.
acceptance: Verify exact eligibility, timing and engine hit consequences.

name: Curve bridge with alternate cost
structure: Use medium threat across multiple development thresholds.
acceptance: Ambessa four/seven energy statements require conditional effective text.

name: Threat resilience by answer class
structure: Choose threats whose legal protections match expected interaction.
acceptance: Never infer blanket immunity; verify specific effects and timing.

name: Friendly-effect compatibility
structure: Compare self-inflicted damage or cost with available protection.
acceptance: Verify exact named targets, prevention and replacement.

name: Expensive-payoff congestion
structure: Avoid support card that cannot be used alongside intended payoff when timing matters.
acceptance: Check actual resource thresholds and alternative sequences.

name: Marginal payoff in winning state
structure: Compare card usefulness before stabilization with extra gain afterward.
acceptance: A card can have meaningful narrow use; test exceptions.

name: Revision after counterexample
structure: Reconsider rejected slot when specific matchup reveals useful interaction window.
acceptance: Verify effect; preserve revision as conditional, no silent inclusion.

name: Protection and replacement value
structure: A replacement effect may preserve a body while another action pays a cost.
acceptance: Source rule citations and card errata need dated official verification.

name: Resource recovery after lost position
structure: Compare losing a point with retaining body, cards and future resource access.
acceptance: No guaranteed recovery; opponent may choose another legal response.

name: Play-order hybrid strategy
structure: Select between ramp payoff and midrange by starting resources and field.
acceptance: Do not equate play order with always correct transformation.

name: Symmetric field opportunity cost
structure: Evaluate a location's benefit to opposing strategy as well as own.
acceptance: Verify actual triggers and field-selection rules.

name: Scoring delay versus resource tax
structure: Compare field effects based on rival tempo and development dependencies.
acceptance: Check alternative routes; not universal advantage.

name: Local field adaptation
structure: Change location selection with expected local opponents and personal testing.
acceptance: Require evidence beyond broad geographic stereotypes.

name: Combined swap validation
structure: Combine universal and conditional replacement quantities before evaluating configuration.
acceptance: Reject unavailable copies and unmatched cuts; preserve source errors.

name: Sideboard inventory contradiction
structure: Detect conflicts between annotation, literal quantities and baseline inventory.
acceptance: Do not silently repair; identify minimal missing decision.

name: Resource threshold scheduling
structure: Work backward from next key development and preserve enough capacity.
acceptance: Arithmetic alone does not certify actions.

name: Tempo override of ramp plan
structure: Spend a reserved resource if immediate threat outweighs delayed payoff.
acceptance: Compare rival closing clock and alternate draws.

name: Duplicate-risk versus access
structure: Compare third copy's higher access with chance of redundant draws.
acceptance: Define sampled population; no measured brick or win rates.

name: Intermediate threat with reserve
structure: Compare maximum-cost deployment with smaller body plus protection.
acceptance: Verify costs, score urgency and response options.

name: Regional innovation and attribution
structure: Show fictional competitors learning from strategies developed outside their familiar local field.
acceptance: Do not generalize countries or reproduce real pilot biography.

name: Reasoned deckbuilding disagreement
structure: Show specialists revising slot preferences after observing exceptions.
acceptance: Original voices and independent stakes, no copied anecdotes.
